No sensor connected yet.

The receiver runs locally. No data is sent to a government agency. AI requests only run when you explicitly generate an AI brief.

A 30-second RoadRelay demo

  1. Show the real signal. Connect the toy car, switch to Live prototype and start recording at checkpoint B. Roll it over a bump.
  2. Follow the evidence. The waveform spikes and an inspection candidate appears. Finish recording. Repeat to add evidence to the same candidate.
  3. Make a decision. Open the candidate, review its signal, choose a team and assign an inspection. Generate a rule-based or AI brief.
  4. Show the larger scenario. Switch to Fleet simulation to demonstrate 20 synthetic vehicles and separate road authorities. Say explicitly that the fleet and locations are simulated.
Presentation wording

“We demonstrate live impact sensing with simulated location tagging. A future field deployment would add GNSS or authorized fleet-location data.”

Green: this observation did not exceed the threshold. Yellow: moderate impact. Red: high impact, suspected road anomaly, inspection needed.

Scenario fleet

20 synthetic vehicle IDs. Three illustrative passes per vehicle. These are not connected vehicles, customers, or field results.

Research & prototype limits

Secondary research informs the workflow. No agency affiliation, interviews, or field deployment is claimed.

  • StreetsLA budget overview · January 28, 2026 ↗

    Reported staff reductions and a projected increase in average pothole repair time. Projections are not actual results.

  • StreetsLA service workflow ↗

    Initial inspection precedes action or referral to another agency.

  • USC Facilities work orders ↗

    Approved service requests link work to labor and material costs.

  • Caltrans District 7 ↗

    State highway responsibility in Los Angeles and Ventura counties.

What this prototype can establish

A live sensor can register an impact and attach it to a manually selected, simulated location. An impact is not a confirmed pothole or a measurement of its depth. No actual GPS, road accuracy, repair savings, automated dispatch, or engineering pavement rating is demonstrated.
